sub_answers.text: Dürr chaired the Bundestag group of FDP parliamentarians from Lower Saxony, Hamburg and Schleswig-Holstein within his parliamentary group. [d21081409s3p0] He served as one of six deputy chairpersons of the FDP parliamentary group, overseeing the group’s activities on finance and budget policy. [d21081409s3p0] In December 2021, he was elected leader of the FDP parliamentary group in the Bundestag, and he was re-elected in 2023 by 93 percent of his parliamentary group members. [d21081409s3p0]

sub_answers.text: Ahead of the 2021 elections, Dürr led the FDP’s campaign in Lower Saxony. [d21081409s3p0] During negotiations to form a traffic light coalition of the SPD, the Greens, and the FDP, Dürr led his party’s delegation in the working group on financial regulation and the national budget. sub_answers.sub_question: Which formal government or judicial proceedings (e.g., inquiries, indictments, prosecutions, or court cases) have been initiated against the politician, and what final resolutions or dispositions were recorded for each?
sub_answers.text: In 2023, four criminal indictments were filed against Donald Trump: state charges in New York and Georgia, and federal charges in Florida and the District of Columbia. [d73425097s0p0] Trump pleaded not guilty to all charges. [d73425097s0p0] He was convicted in New York, but the charges were dropped in the Georgia case. [d73425097s0p0] The two federal cases were dismissed, and the Supreme Court ruled in July 2024 that Trump had immunity for official presidential acts while not having immunity for unofficial acts. [d73425097s0p0]

sub_answers.text: Within the FDP parliamentary group, Christian Dürr chaired the Bundestag group of FDP parliamentarians from Lower Saxony, Hamburg and Schleswig-Holstein. [d21081409s3p0] He also served as one of six deputy chairpersons of the FDP parliamentary group under chairman Christian Lindner, overseeing the group’s activities on finance and budget policy. [d21081409s3p0] In December 2021, Dürr was elected leader of the FDP parliamentary group in the Bundestag, succeeding Christian Lindner. [d21081409s3p0]

sub_answers.text: On 27 January 2011, new corruption charges against Yulia Tymoshenko were filed over alleged use of 1,000 medical vehicles for campaigning in the 2010 presidential elections. [d1246843s29p0] In June 2011, the case on the "Kyoto money" and medical assistance vehicles was suspended after an investigation by BDO USA and Covington & Burling concluded the cases were "not worth the paper on which they are written." [d1246843s29p0] A third criminal case alleging abuse of power during the 2009 Russia–Ukraine gas dispute was opened on 10 April 2011 and prosecutors charged her on 24 May 2011, with her not arrested. [d1246843s29p0]
